high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Reuters, dated 20 hours prior to the time the screenshot was taken. The headline reads: "Meta poaches 28-year-old Scale AI CEO after taking multibillion dollar stake in startup." Below the headline, there is a subheading that repeats the main headline. The article mentions that Facebook-owner Meta has invested in Scale AI, valuing the data-labeling startup at $29 billion. As part of this investment, Meta has brought in its 28-year-old CEO, Alexandr Wang, to play a prominent role in the tech giant's artificial intelligence strategy.
